scenes.text: Everyone wants to become a profitable trader. Nobody talks about what it costs.
Charts at 3 AM. Plans you keep cancelling. The work is real, and nobody around you can see it.
Six losses in a row. Same plan. Same rules. A streak doesn’t prove your plan is broken.
Frustration funds the revenge trade. The revenge trade funds the doubt. Notice it. Name it. Step away.
Zoom out. One day, the struggle that almost made you quit will become the reason you never give up.
